name: ktv-desktop
description: Windows 桌面版 KTV 点歌系统（Electron + Vue 3 + libVLC + muse.db 曲库 + 在线取流）

scripts.setup: pwsh -File poc/player/fetch-vlc.ps1 && pwsh -File poc/player/fetch-mpv.ps1 && pwsh -File poc/player/fetch-node.ps1 && pwsh -File poc/player/make-testmedia.ps1
scripts.test:catalog: npm --prefix services/catalog test && npm --prefix services/catalog run test:server
scripts.test: npm run test:player && npm run test:shell && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:api && npm run smoke
